parse_link: parse a title and link from text formatted as 'title <url>' using the link_regexp pattern
abbr_role: create a docutils abbreviation node from reStructuredText role text with an optional title
register_mcss: register the abbr local role with the docutils reStructuredText parser for m.css plugins
link_regexp: match text in the format 'title <link>' using a compiled regex with named groups title and link
set_classes: apply CSS classes to docutils node options using the set_classes helper from rst.roles
